reviews.text: A very positive experience, prepared doctors and kind nurses. Family atmosphere.
The best veterinary clinic, with trained doctors and assistants

We had an appointment for a basic dental cleaning for a dog. Specifically asked prior NOT to remove any tooth. During the procedure they decided to remove 2 teeth, ignored the verbal notice entirely, without any alert or asking for permission first, leaving the dog with 2 missing front teeth, gaslighting us to believe this is the best for the dog, because the teeth was slightly moving. This is irreversible damage. How is this normal?
Endless kindness every time we come, short waiting time, fairy doctors and nurses
I've been coming here for years, they're very nice and friendly

We have been to the clinic several times, fortunately only once with a specific complaint and then only for routine vaccinations. We have been lucky enough to see several doctors, and we have been 100% satisfied with everyone, in fact..! Thank you very much for your work!
Recently, to our great sorrow, the attitude of some doctors has deteriorated a lot.
They are the best in the world. They always do their best. Everyone is kind and dedicated. Thank you very much.

We have been here a few times over the years.
They have answered all our questions helpfully and have given us lots of advice.
I have been lucky enough to see all the doctors now and I am completely satisfied so far.
We always come here, everyone in the office is knowledgeable, kind and helpful. Thank you for your care! Rózsika and Zita

Thank you very much for your expertise, quick and professional work, Dr. Mag Fáta, I am grateful that you freed my dog ​​from the tick that had burrowed into his paw.

(They couldn't get it out in three weeks at another vet's office, even though they operated on him.)

I am very grateful to them!
We first visited them with our elderly Staffie dog Sárika about 8 years ago. She had pneumonia and is 12 years old. In an 11th district clinic, they said that the dog would not survive, she is old anyway, let's put her to sleep! After that, we found this clinic and brought Sárika here.
After the necessary tests, they said that there was no question of anesthesia, the dog would receive a few infusions and everything would be fine. We took her for infusions every day and our Sárika recovered. The last treatment was very touching because as we brought her out of the treatment room, Sárika walked around the clinic as if to thank her for the care. The doctors and nurses who were there stood around her and applauded her! I have never experienced anything like this anywhere. After the treatments, Sárika was able to stay with us for another 4 years, that's all she got from this super team. We now have a staff (this is Réka) and we go here with her, I would never take her anywhere else! Thank you first and foremost to Dr Tamás Ladányi, nurse Réka, but to the whole team, how are you doing for us! Good luck!🥰🙏
I've been going to them for 16 years, now with my 3rd dog. They are kind, professional, and direct.

They saw us without an appointment because our cat suddenly had a minor problem. They were very helpful and kind in dealing with the situation. The doctor and her assistant were very reassuring and nice to us. We will continue to go to them! We can only recommend them!!

It's been almost 10 years since we chose Pozsonyi Doki's clinic with our two dogs. The professionalism and personality of Dr. Tamás Ladányi are the main reasons. But we also have very good experiences with the other doctors, Dr. Ferenc Krausz, Doctor Georgina no longer works with them, but we liked her very much. We moved to the countryside, and we prefer to go up to the more acute cases. I highly recommend the Team!
We visited them twice with my dog ​​and both times they were very kind, helpful and "economical". :-)

They are kind, helpful..
And Dr. Ladányi is the best, very professional, always diagnoses well, he saved the life of my 16-year-old puppy last time. I will be forever grateful for him! I recommend the doctor to everyone from the bottom of my heart!
It's a mess, the animals are on a conveyor belt, the staff is chaotic. I don't recommend them.

I highly recommend them 😊
They were very kind and helpful! …
Very quick and easy online booking, excellent service, our 10 week old spaniel didn't even notice the vaccination. I can only recommend it!

My experience with this veterinary clinic was completely unacceptable. About 1 year ago I brought my cat in with suspicion of undescended testicles, and we agreed in advance that a special ultrasound examination was necessary. Despite this, they performed an unnecessary, general ultrasound, which would have cost me an additional 35 thousand forints. I also asked for that and the price of the other ultrasound. Only after a long discussion were they willing to release the 35 thousand forints, which shows that this amount means a lot to them, but they expect it to not matter to us and to throw it out the window without a word. This is the attitude that can be read in other reviews, which suggests that they are only interested in money, not healing. On top of that, they have now banned my cat, while it did not occur to them that I had taken my other cat several times since the incident (and of course I paid everything that was a legitimate fee without any problems). It's pretty funny how they understand... :) And the fact that I was able to get over the incident, and they're banning me (an animal) for something that's 1 year old, like an offended, vengeful child. Pathetic.

I have been a customer for 12 years maybe now - I used to take my previous dog there and I go there with our new dog too. From the bottom of my heart, thanks to all the clinic team. Dr. Krausz as well as every other doctor and nurse has been AMAZING, caring, and kind. They truly do it because they love animals. If I’ve visited another doctor in the clinic, our usual vet often checks in to make sure everything is in order. And to my big surprise, their prices are so fair and have changed little. Truly a gem of a clinic, I can wholeheartedly recommend this place. ❤️

I was there with my cat about a year ago. Her tooth hurt, she was given medication and they said that 1 or 2 of her teeth would have to be pulled out, but they could do that too. I took her back after 1-2 weeks, but by then they had already figured out that I should take her somewhere else! Of course, they gave her more medication, did blood tests, and X-rays. I had already asked for a Felv/Fiv test, which came back Fiv +. The doctor didn't think of that. It was a strange feeling to leave the clinic after paying 95 thousand forints for the two appointments but they didn't even touch her teeth. By the way, they examined the cat, everything was fine! After that, I looked for another doctor, they pulled 11 of her teeth, there was a bump on her back, they operated on a purulent cyst, and they treated her nose for squamous cell carcinoma. Now my cat looks like she's 5 years younger. I feel like changing doctors was a good idea.

We go to Dr.Mag Fáta with my 2 cats and he is the best doctor possible!
He is very very kind and everything always goes perfectly!
I have never seen such a kind doctor as him and he treats my cats as if they were his own! I highly recommend him!🩷 …

We have been going to Dr. Tamas Ladányi with our dwarf rabbit for four years, and we have always been satisfied with the care. We also have our nails trimmed, spayed and vaccinated here. We always book an appointment in advance. Very kind and professional team!

We have been going to this clinic for a few years with two cats and our experience has been by far the most positive. We have been lucky enough to see each of the doctors and have received uniformly kind, attentive, and informative care. The assistance and reception are also similar. I recommend it to everyone, because your pet really matters here! 🙏

Fáta Mag Dr. is the best veterinarian for CATS!!! She and her Assistant were absolute angels with my cat, even though my cat was terrified. They are incredibly professional, while also being very gentle, friendly, and humane towards the cats and understanding them. Not many veterinarians understand cats as much as they understand dogs so I was very impressed! Safe to say she will be my go-to vet for my cat! 10/10. Good pricing, great service.
The best :)

In the hands of Dr. Tamás Ladányi, two dwarf bunnies and a small dog successfully underwent the difficulties of neutering. It was very nice that after the surgery I received an SMS that my little animals were doing well. Dr. Tímea Tóbiás is also attentive, kind and I recommend the whole team to everyone with a warm heart! Thank you very much! :)

Twice out of two times, there was at least a half-hour delay compared to the 8 am appointment because they would call friends in before the appointment. We waited with our elderly cat, who was very bad at carrying the carrier, and stressed herself to the point of being sick (poor thing meowed the whole time), because “unfortunately there was a delay” already at the opening. We made an appointment a week in advance for the opening, writing that it would be an annual vaccination. The receptionist was phlegmatic, when we asked when we could come in, when 3 other dogs (some of whom arrived after us) had already been called in, the answer was a cursory “soon”. Finally, the other doctor took pity on our cat and called her in for the 5-minute vaccination. Another time, the doctor botched the worming, the cat spat it out at first, and they were able to bill both (unfortunately, we only checked the bill at home). They may be good with dogs, but I wouldn't recommend them with cats, they don't seem to like them.
They found a solution to our phone inquiry immediately. Very nice, attentive team, good communicators, nice professionals. I can only recommend them.
Well-trained doctors, friendly place! I can only recommend it!

A company of empathetic and enthusiastic professionals working at a reasonable price.
We had our little dog chipped and vaccinated, the treatment took a maximum of 20 minutes, including administration, examination and injections. They are very fast, kind and excellent value for money. I can only recommend this place to everyone!
Very nice and competent people! Easy to make an appointment online and easy to communicate (I don’t speak Hungarian). Thank you!
Unfortunately, our cat could not be saved, but the doctors here tried their best to help her the whole time.
I definitely cannot recommend it.

I would never set foot here again and I would not recommend it to anyone else. The vet who is waiting for the emergency dog ​​said that the order should be kept and it is better to give a periodic vaccination than to look at the poisoned puppy that I have been waiting for for 30 minutes and it does not deserve a single moment. I saw Tobias Timea today. Luckily we found a vet who understands the gravity of the situation in Szégy!!!
Very nice team and professional care, thank you!

I am very grateful to them because I arrived with my cat for the first time in the last hour and there was no question that they would welcome us, even though there were several people waiting. They examined my cat thoroughly and took wonderful care of it, she received everything she needed and also provided her with home medicine and ointment. We were ready in 50 minutes, although I did not feel that they were in a hurry to take care of my cat. Thank you very much Dr. Tímea Tóbiás, I will definitely go here if anything happens in the future.
Cool place, everyone is professional and cute. Of course we didn't ask about the dog :-)

Living nearby the vet clinic, I come across with my dog and always find on time service, even without an appointment. Through the last years I came here multiple times and never encountered a non speaking English doctor.

I am very happy to have found this clinic! Dr. Tímea Tóbiás' expertise and attention are impressive - it is clear that she does her job with all her heart and soul. She performed a thorough examination and answered all my questions patiently and clearly.
The kindness and professionalism of the assistants (I remember Vera and Eszter by name, but everyone was really great) perfectly complement the medical care. They treated our little monster gently and helped to make the examination go smoothly, which is quite difficult for an owner when their little pet is sick.
The clinic's modern equipment and cleanliness are also outstanding. It is clear that the welfare of the animals is truly the priority here. It was a special pleasure to see how harmoniously the professionals work together for the animals' recovery.
I strongly recommend her to everyone, after several veterinarians, they were finally able to make a diagnosis and provide treatment for us.

We recently found the clinic, but one thing is for sure, we won't go anywhere else from now on! Doctor Timi and Vera helped us a lot when we came there with our sick dog. Doctor Timi treated our dog with incredible patience and love. Her expertise is impressive (as far as I can tell lol) she tries to give a thorough explanation of everything, tells us what is happening and what the best solution is. We feel completely safe with our dog in her hands! I can only recommend her to everyone who is looking for a truly professional, conscientious and caring doctor. Thank you Timi and Vera! (And to everyone at the clinic)
They treat patients with contempt. They don't take responsibility.

No one should bring their pet here! In December, one of our cats had to have a tooth pulled out, unfortunately. In February, I noticed that the tooth that was pulled out was not pulled out, but the top was broken off and the root was left inside. On February 10, the root that was left inside was removed, which was an unnecessary surgery for him. On February 13, the cat vomited all day and had to be taken to the emergency room. Unfortunately, it turned out that he had intestinal inflammation and the chip that was implanted in him in December was not registered either. Doctors who put this together: Fáta Mag, Tímea Tóbiás.
Very helpful and professional doctors. Well-equipped clinic.
The best veterinary clinic! ;) I can only recommend the helpful and dedicated doctors and assistants.

We would like to thank the medical team this morning for their kind, loving work and quick help. We visited the clinic due to an eye injury. After a quick diagnosis, they referred us to an ophthalmologist and provided us with all the help we could. Our puppy is fine. A few days and everything will be back to normal. Tummy and his loving owner 💖💖💖

They are always very kind and helpful.
We thank you for everything with a chaotic kitty Dr. Tamás Ladányi ❤️

We used to come here with my bunny, now we came with my spaniel. The waiting room was calm, it seemed like a well-functioning, well-established team. Csücsök felt really good :)))
Thank you for the examination and the extra kindness to Dr. Krausz and his colleagues! We hope not too often, but we will come again! :))

We have been going here with my puppy for years, the doctors and assistants are ALWAYS nice:)
The clinic is very nice, modern, clean, well equipped!!!
I can only recommend it to everyone.
Very professional team, including the care:)
Friendly place, nice colleagues, I can only recommend it.

They are very kind and professional. It is clear that they really love animals and are not “just doing their job”. They always have 1-2 good tips for the owners. I highly recommend Dr. Fáta Mag. 💫🙌🏼 …

Yesterday we were the first to visit the clinic with 2 kittens, thank you very much to everyone who took care of them, they received great devotion and love from everyone! And we were a huge relief because all the problems were discovered and treated right away!
Whatever other problems we had, we would definitely come back here.
Thank you!
The two bad bones greet the entire staff from here too!

Our best experience with animal clinics so far. I came with my 12 year old cat, the assistants and doctors were professional and very kind and helpful.
Thank you!

We have been going to them with two cats for a very long time, and they have always treated us with maximum attention, patience and expertise. I would like to especially highlight Dr. Fáta Mag and her assistant, their kindness is boundless towards both the owners and their pets. I wholeheartedly recommend them to everyone!

We have been taking our dog to this clinic for years and this is the first time we have brought our cat.
The clinic has a friendly atmosphere. The vets and assistants are incredibly kind and professional!
We've been coming here for 12 years. I love it. It's not that cool, but it's not their fault. 😁 …

My foreign friend was almost dropped off at another clinic the day before his trip, and I referred him to the Bratislava Pet Clinic because of my previous great experience.
The overwhelming helpfulness and expertise he received was simply extraordinary and heartwarming! Thank you so much on behalf of him and his cats! 🌸🙏 I couldn't give 6 stars, but I would. ✨✨

I followed our favorite vet here, unfortunately it is much more expensive than where he worked before. The office itself is very well equipped, professional ultrasound equipment and operating room. The examination rooms open from each other, which I think is not very practical, because a dog came in during the examination.
The receptionist was very nice, as was our vet's assistant, so the house cannot be faulted regarding the service. 🙂
The lab was also available the next day, even though we were there late in the afternoon, so that's also a plus.
